notes.title: Update Notes Version v0.22.9.25
notes.content:
Today's Update[olist]
Fixed initial tutorial issues

Added tutorial guidance for early mech switching

Fixed issue with Star Map skills triggered by movement

Added text descriptions for the radial menu

Fixed issue where Sword Qi would not trigger skills

New players now start with all skill stones unlocked

notes.title: Update Notes Version v0.21.9.24
notes.content:
Update Notes[olist]
Skill Adjustments

Fixed an issue where all 4 active skills dealt true damage.

Buff Fixes

Fixed an issue where player buffs were applied at full stacks immediately.

Fixed incorrect tooltip display when hovering the mouse over buffs.

Language & Display

Fixed incorrect language display in the English version.

Gameplay Adjustments

All 3 starting mechs are now unlocked from the beginning.

Miracle item exchange no longer costs 1000 Spirit Coins and is now free.

Leaderboard Fixes

Fixed issues with the Battlefield leaderboard.

Fixed issues with the Energy Tower leaderboard.

BD Recommendation System

Fixed an issue where switching recommended BD caused gems to be recycled.
[/olist]

notes.title: Tides of the Endless: Rising Tide Demo is Now Live!
notes.content:
🌊 Tides of the Endless: Rising Tide Demo is Now Live![p align="start"]Dear players, thank you so much for your patience!
We are a brand-new indie team. Although we faced many challenges during development, with passion and persistence we’ve finally reached this important milestone.
[p align="start"]Today, the Tides of the Endless: Rising Tide Demo is officially available!
Here’s what you can experience in this version:
🔓 Demo Content[olist]
3 Mechs – freely switch between different mechs at any time.

4 Dimensional Worlds – explore the early dimensional stages and discover the world.

Forging System – upgrade and adjust equipment stats through crafting.

Set System – combine different gear slots to unlock \[Mechanism Gem] effects.

4 Battlefields – challenge various battlefields and obtain powerful loot.

Multiple Gear Rarities – \[White], \[Blue], \[Green], \[Yellow].

Star Chart System – customize your build with unique progression paths.

Destiny Disk System – freely combine destiny disks to enhance your build.

Equipment Crafting System – any gear that has dropped can be recreated through crafting.

And much more – hidden surprises await!
[/olist]🔧 Ongoing Updates
This Demo is an early-stage build, and we will keep improving it based on your feedback.

We plan to update at least once every 2 days, adding more content and optimizations.
🙌 Thank You[p align="start"]We are a small passionate team, aiming to create a fast-paced and exciting ARPG experience.
We hope this Demo shows you the fun and intensity we want to deliver.
📢 Join Us[p align="start"]👉 Join our Official Discord Community to chat directly with the developers and share feedback.
👉 Don’t forget to add the game to your Wishlist to stay updated on future releases!

notes.title: Update Notes Version v0.10.7.22 (July 22, 2025)
notes.content:
【Major Update Notes】

Active Skill System Overhaul
Each mech's active skills have been changed from 4 fixed skills to 2 freely swappable ones, greatly increasing build flexibility.

Starmap Gem Upgrade Optimization
Starmap gems can now be upgraded more intuitively through direct editing, improving ease of use.

Fusion Value Mechanic Adjustment
Before reaching 400 Fusion Value, all world monsters will no longer generate ground-based lingering debuffs, reducing early-game combat pressure.

New In-Game Guides
Additional tutorials and system guides have been added to help both new and returning players understand core mechanics more quickly.

Lowered Starmap Unlock Requirement
The requirement to fully unlock the starmap has been reduced from 400 Fusion Value to 200.

Visual Enhancements
Removed certain blood effects in maps that interfered with camera visibility, improving visual clarity and combat readability.

Battlefield Structure Simplification
The number of battlefield stages has been streamlined from 8 to 4, enhancing overall pacing and stage quality.

Energy Tower Bug Fix
Fixed an issue where Energy Tower layers could exceed 100 floors abnormally.
